headline: Is Allstate (ALL) Fairly Valued After Bullish Analyst Revisions Ahead Of Earnings?

headline: Allstate (ALL) Stock May Trade At A Discount Following Catastrophe Losses
summary: Allstate stock has delivered a strong 146.8% return over the past three years, which raises a clear tension for investors between that share price strength and whether the current level still reflects good value. The 146.8% three year return suggests the market has already repriced Allstate significantly, so the key issue is how much of the company’s potential is now embedded in the stock.
